Records.description: Non-planar six-point two-loop graph (Fig. 2(c)): massless, 8 vertices (6 external, 2 internal), 9 internal propagators, verified 2-loop via L = E - V + 1 = 9 - 8 + 1 = 2. This is the paper's most demanding example: 45 new Landau singularities relative to PLDdata, the largest of length ~1e8 and total degree 36, with the largest singularity requiring an AMD EPYC 9575F 64-core cluster with ~100 GB memory.
